No split pane, no source-and-preview dance. `⌘S` s"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"aves through a version guard, so you never overwrite someone else's edit."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"> MarkText is an Electron desktop app. This plugin doesn't ship its shell — it takes the editor core"},{"id":"p7s2","text":" MarkText extracts (`@muyajs/core` / muya, MIT) and adds only the DSH integration. Everything runs locally."},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## Why it feels different"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"- **✍️ You edit the document, not the source.** Markdown markers stay hidden; headings, lists, table"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"s and quotes are real elements. Put the caret in a table cell and fix the cell, not a row of pipes.
"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"- **💬 Quote straight into the chat.** Select any text, hit **Quote** in the toolbar, and a Markdown "},{"id":"p9s4","text":"blockquote — with the file path on top — is appended to the composer draft. No retyping, no "the thi"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"rd bullet under section 2".
- **📄 Export a real PDF.** **PDF** in the toolbar (or `⌘P`) turns the op"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"en document into an A4 `.pdf`, writes it **next to the file** and opens it in the sidebar so you can"},{"id":"p9s7","text":" check the result — no print dialog, no download prompt, no "Save as PDF" detour. The document is re"},{"id":"p9s8","text":"-laid out at page width first, so text is a normal size instead of a sidebar-width strip, and pages "},{"id":"p9s9","text":"break on blank rows so a line of text is never sliced in half.
- **📊 Diagrams and math just render.*"},{"id":"p9s10","text":"* KaTeX, Mermaid, Vega and PlantUML ship with the plugin and load on demand — offline, no CDN, no ac"},{"id":"p9s11","text":"count.
- **🖼️ Images land where you expect.** `![](assets/diagram.png)` resolves against the documen"},{"id":"p9s12","text":"t's own folder, so docs written in your editor look right here.
- **💾 Saving is boring, in the best "},{"id":"p9s13","text":"way.** Autosave 2.5 s after you stop typing; `⌘S` saves immediately; a changed file on disk means a "},{"id":"p9s14","text":"conflict banner, never a silent overwrite.
- **🌗 It looks like DSH.** Light and dark follow the host"},{"id":"p9s15","text":", and the editor never adopts a foreign theme.
- **⌨️ Your fingers already know it.** `⌘Z` / `⇧⌘Z` u"},{"id":"p9s16","text":"ndo and redo, `⌘S` saves, `⌘P` exports a PDF, `⌘F` finds — nothing to relearn."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"## Install in one line"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"**Using the Desktop app?** Open **Plugins → Add plugin → Install a third-party plugin**, enter `dsh-"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"marktext`, click **Enable now**, then restart the app once. The iframe isolate"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"s all of that; only document, theme and save calls cross the boundary."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"Message protocol (v1) and the file-policy fallback"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Envelope: `{ __dshmkt: true, dir: 'down' | 'up', type, content }`"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Direction | type | content |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"| down | `doc` | `{ path, displayPath, text, version, dark, locale }` |

| down | `chat-"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"inserted` | `{ mode: 'draft' \| 'clipboard' \| 'none' }` |

| up | `open-external` | `{ href }` |"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**Quoting into the chat.** The client resolves the tab's session, asks `ctx.conversation.input.for(s"},{"id":"p29s2","text":"essionCtx)` for the composer facade, and appends `buildQuote(selection, path)` to the current draft "},{"id":"p29s3","text":"with `setDraft`. The composer keeps its own history, so the quote is one undo step away. If the host"},{"id":"p29s4","text":" doesn't expose the conversation service (older DSH, or a profile without the conversation plugin), "},{"id":"p29s5","text":"the quote goes to the clipboard instead and the toolbar says so — the feature degrades, it doesn't d"},{"id":"p29s6","text":" goes to the clipboard instead and the toolbar says so — the feature degrades, it doesn't disappear."},{"id":"p30s1","text":"**Saving and the file policy.** The normal path is `ctx.fs.writeText(target, text, { kind: 'replaceI"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"fVersion', version })`; a stale version returns `FS_STALE_VERSION` and the UI shows a conflict banne"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"r. If the host policy refuses the write (`FS_SANDBOX_DENIED`, e.g. `workspace-write` / `read-only`),"},{"id":"p30s4","text":" the save falls back to Node's `fs.writeFile` **with the version guard intact** — the version is che"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"cked before and re-read after. Real OS errors (`EACCES` / `EPERM`) still surface as-is."}],"truncated":true}
